glossary.definition: As used in this section, "hazardous material" means any material that is designated as such under the "Hazardous Materials Transportation Act," 88 Stat. 2156 (1975), 49 U.S.C.A. 1801, as amended, and regulations adopted under it.
glossary.source_title: Section 3737.80 - Chief of fire department responsible for primary coordination in emergency situation.
